findings.summary: EndpointSlices are said to list only ready Pods, but they also include not-ready endpoints.
findings.fix: Say "Only ready endpoints receive traffic". EndpointSlices record readiness in a `ready` condition. Not-ready Pods stay in the slice with `ready: false`, and the legacy Endpoints object puts them under `notReadyAddresses`.
